array.string: OP=/Users/genishii/Client/_Dent/claude-code/operation WT="$HOME/.dent/ah-main" export DENT_WIKI=/Users/genishii/Client/_Dent/claude-code/wiki cd "$OP" git worktree remove --force "$WT" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$WT"; git worktree prune if git fetch -q origin main && git worktree add -q --detach "$WT" origin/main && ln -s "$OP/review/node_modules" "$WT/review/node_modules"; then cd "$WT" && node scripts/all-hands/build-ah.mjs; rc=$? cd "$OP" && git worktree remove --force "$WT" exit $rc fi echo "[ah] main の worktree を作れなかったので作業フォルダのスクリプトで実行します" exec node scripts/all-hands/build-ah.mjs
